EMQX 5.8.9 was documented in 2026.
Dashboard default login is admin / public; change it immediately.
ngrok authtoken: <your ngrok authtoken>
NGROK_AUTHTOKEN=your_authtoken
EMQX_NODE__COOKIE = <your-cluster-cookie>
EMQX_DASHBOARD__DEFAULT_PASSWORD=change-me
password = "<your password>"
password = "public"
"password": "<redacted>"
API key: <your-api-key>
api_key = YOUR_KEY
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
"Authorization": "Authorization"
MQTT connection uses broker host and port only, without inline credentials.
TLS private key is stored separately and never committed.
Example documentation address 192.168.1.10.
Use documentation prefixes fc00::/7 and fe80::/10 only as examples.
